name: Gainsight (Staircase AI)
description: Bring in live customer intelligence from Gainsight's Staircase AI including customer sentiment, risk, engagement and insights - so every answer, insight, and recommendation is grounded in real customer context.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Gainsight (Staircase AI) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Gainsight (Staircase AI) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.staircase.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Gainsight (Staircase AI) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gainsight (Staircase AI) provides these MCP tools: staircase_query and staircase_fetch_evidence.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Gainsight (Staircase AI)?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Gainsight (Staircase AI) in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Gainsight (Staircase AI) MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gainsight (Staircase AI) requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Gainsight (Staircase AI) is developed by Gainsight. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
